title: Launch HN: Bloomy (YC S26) – AI-powered mastery learning for K-12
summary: Bloomy is an AI-powered mastery learning platform for K-12 students that provides personalized learning paths, diagnostic assessments to identify skill gaps, and a Socratic AI tutor for Math, ELA, and Writing subjects without giving away direct answers.
problem_solved: Provides scalable personalized learning and AI tutoring to help K-12 students fill skill gaps without requiring expensive 1:1 human tutors.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to personalized, mastery-based education by using AI to provide individualized instruction and scaffolding at scale.
